ns2:section.sectionText: Students enrolled in this section will meet with one of the others 391 sections. Students wishing to enroll in this section should review the other 391 section project offerings and identify one of interest; ensure that the scheduled class time for the section of interest fits with their class schedule; email the JS1 section instructor for approval, indicating the section of interest. Students enrolled in the section will be required to write a final reflection paper that meets specific JS1 Community-Engagement and the Arts requirements. Section JS1 is restricted to James Scholars in all campus units. Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to James Scholars Program students.
